honest_framing_note: Wf-49 PARTIAL SHIP anchored |ρ| ≤ 0.204 across pooled 26801 rows but never split per-metal. Wf-71 P3 close-out splits strict-scaffold and reports per-cohort macro R² + aggregate. Wf-128 P3 3-way cross-dataset verify on tmQM 29 (29/29 PASS vs Hilbert; lift +4.38 mean R² over Hilbert) confirms the 3-way integration is a consistent lift over single-stream Hilbert on REAL d-block DFT data. The absolute combined R² = -40.24 (median -27.74; range -7.27 to -297.20) is WORSE than the Wf-71 P3 macro R² = +0.24 because: (1) the Wf-128 P3 feature stack is 172-d zero-padded (no real Multi-PH or PLL data for tmQM); (2) the ASTSR [0, 1] clip regime + Wasserstein weight 0.05 combine to push predictions into the constant-tail region; (3) 4 of 29 elements (Pd, Tc, Hf, Pt) flag collapse on at least 1 seed. Architectural lift requires Multi-PH + PLL feature augmentation (Wf-94 R20-P3).
